item.title: Salman Khan Arrives at Vile Parle Crematorium in Mumbai as Dharmendra Deol Passes Away
item.description: Deol Passes Away latest News: Actor and Bigg Boss 19 host Salman Khan on Monday afternoon, at around 2:10 pm, arrived at the Vile Parle Crematorium in Mumbai as reports claim that veteran actor Dharmendra Deol has passed away.

item.title: India-Canada Trade Talks Relaunch: Paving the Way for USD 50 Billion Bilateral Growth
item.description: India and Canada are set to relaunch negotiations on a long-awaited free trade agreement. It is a significant step in reviving economic ties after relations had a diplomatic low last year. On Monday, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal confirmed that the two nations would begin discussions on a high-ambition Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), which is focused on raising bilateral trade to USD 50 billion by 2030.

item.title: Irreplaceable Loss for Indian Film World: From HM Amit Shah to LoP Rahul Gandhi, Tributes Pour In for Dharmendra Deol
item.description: As legendary actor Dharmendra Deol passed away on Monday, tributes poured in from across the country, including from top political leaders. Among those who mourned his demise were Home Minister Amit Shah and Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi.

item.title: From Farm to Table: Govt Urges Hotels to Partner with Farmers for Fresh and Organic Produce
item.description: Agriculture Secretary Devesh Chaturvedi urged hotels and restaurants across India to procure produce directly from farmer-producer organisations (FPOs). This is a significant move for strengthening the link between farmers and the hospitality sector. The move is focused on improving returns for growers by cutting out middlemen from the supply chain.

item.title: “Every home had a favourite Dharmendra film”: Cricketer Yuvraj Singh pays tribute to ‘He-Man'
item.description: Known for his simplicity, veteran actor Dharmendra Deol was given a quiet and simple last rite, attended by top Bollywood personalities including Amitabh Bachchan and Salman Khan.

item.title: PM Modi to Participate in 350th Shaheedi Diwas of Guru Tegh Bahadur and International Gita Mahotsav in Kurukshetra
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is going to visit Kurukshetra, Haryana, on Tuesday, November 25. He is going to participate in two major events—the International Gita Mahotsav and the state-level commemoration of the 350th martyrdom anniversary of Guru Tegh Bahadur, the revered ninth Sikh Guru.

item.title: November 25 Public Holiday Alert: Honoring Guru Tegh Bahadur's 350th Martyrdom Anniversary
item.description: In Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and several other northern states, a public holiday has been declared on Tuesday, 25th November, 2025. It is to mark the 350th Shaheedi Diwas of Guru Tegh Bahadur, the ninth Sikh Guru. Earlier the day was listed as a restricted holiday, but now it has been elevated to a full public holiday. Government offices and schools are closed across the capital.
